bank.question: In the context of rehabilitation, which action best reflects the NHS value 'Improving Lives'?
bank.explanation: Improving Lives often involves empowering patients with the skills and confidence to manage their health independently
options: Doing all daily tasks for the patient so they can rest
Reminding the patient that their health is entirely their own responsibility
Supporting a patient to use a new mobility aid to regain independence
Discouraging a patient from setting goals that might be too difficult

bank.question: Under the value 'Everyone Counts', it is acceptable to prioritise patients based on their social status or influence
bank.explanation: The value 'Everyone Counts' means the NHS must use its resources fairly and effectively to ensure no one is excluded or left behind

bank.question: How can a hospital department best demonstrate the value 'Everyone Counts'?
bank.explanation: Everyone Counts requires seeking out and valuing the views of those who may feel unheard or marginalised
options: Using a standard survey that is only available in English
Holding feedback meetings during standard working hours only
Assuming that no complaints means all patients are satisfied
Actively seeking feedback from minority groups about their experience of the service
